Start with Memotto

Memotto is a note-taking app that allows you to combine text, tables, and images into one place.
This guide will explain how to use Memotto with examples from two different departments: Public Relations (Yamasaki) and Sales (Takanashi).

Short notes that accompany a page are called "Quick Notes."
Yamanashi keeps important decisions in her Quick Notes.
Yamanashi uses sticky notes to mark important sections.
You can add up to ten items per page.

For use within a team
Mr. Kotoharu's sales team first created a workspace.
The area within the workspace that everyone can see is called "ひろば" (Commons).

Anyone can post notes in the "Commons."
Mr. Kotoyasu shares his daily sales plans with the team in the "Commons" every morning.
You can invite team members to the "Space" via email.
Invited users will receive a confirmation email.

Once approved by the administrator, you can immediately join.
You can also change the permissions for each member within a specific space.
Synchronization and history

Notes are automatically saved and synchronized across all devices.
You can also edit them offline, and they will be synchronized immediately when you reconnect.
You can revert to a previous version from the page history.
Ms. Tsukimori was able to recover the text she accidentally deleted.

Tips for organization:
It's helpful to pin important pages so you can easily access them.
Pinned pages will be displayed at the top of the list.

Using tags on notes in Hiroba makes them easier to find.
You can create tags freely.
Mr. Kotoharu uses different tags for each project.
The same tag can be used for single words or phrases.

When searching, you can find both "hiroba" and "hito" at the same time.
If you can't find what you're looking for, try expanding the search range.
